frontmatter.name: ui-consistency-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Use after any change to a .svelte file under src/lib/components, src/lib/layout, src/lib/article, or src/routes — reviews it against this repo's design tokens and shared UI primitives to catch reinvented patterns, hardcoded fallbacks, missing empty/error states, ad-hoc dialogs, and inconsistent layout widths.
